records: final-evaluation records of the frozen v2 suite (configs/v2/suites/final.jsonl); learned policies: seed-11 runs
ordering: case ID ascending (string order); first match wins
renderer: Newton Warp ray-traced RGB camera (A100 has no RT cores); physics PhysX unchanged; single-environment replay

categories.rule: first joint_early_2cm_030 case on which nominal fails
categories.fallback: first case (any condition) on which nominal fails

categories.rule: first case in timing_early_015, joint_early_1cm_015 or joint_early_2cm_030 where ablation_1cm_A (alignment, no release gate) ends in a drop and ablation_1cm_AG succeeds
categories.fallback: first case (any condition) where ablation_1cm_A fails and ablation_1cm_AG succeeds; if none, first drop of ablation_1cm_A

categories.rule: first case where geometry_1cm fails and geometry_1p5cm succeeds
categories.fallback: first case where bound_0p005 fails and geometry_1cm succeeds

categories.rule: first extrapolation case where combined_seed11 (selected) succeeds and geometry_1p5cm fails
categories.fallback: first case where combined_seed11 (selected) succeeds and const_geometry_1p5cm fails; then first extrapolation success of combined_seed11 (selected)
first case where combined_seed11 (final) fails; if none, the category is reported empty and the first case where residual_seed11 (selected) fails is shown instead

categories.rule: first case where residual_seed11 (selected) succeeds and nominal fails
